data.title: 长离 · 今州红绸的花嫁授课
data.description: 【今州山庭·清晨】长离穿着红白层叠婚纱站在山庭长廊，一手拿着由凤凰羽毛与白花装饰的花扇；她将另一手伸向镜头示范礼仪步伐，在花瓣飘落间微笑，像把耐心也变成了誓约。
data.action: 山庭长廊示范一段礼仪步伐，花瓣落下时收势微笑
data.lighting: clear morning light on red railings
data.mood: 老师把耐心教成花嫁誓约
data.promptProse: She extends one hand toward the viewer to demonstrate a ceremonial step, holding the flower fan at her side with the other. Morning light crosses the red railing and phoenix embroidery as petals fall.
data.animaCaption: One hand demonstrates the step toward the viewer; the other holds the flower fan.
